mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stompall_chat ( roomId, writer, msgTime, message ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{writer}, #{msgTime}, #{message} )
mapper.select: SELECT sec.id , sec.roomId , ser.roomName AS roomName , sec.writer , sec.msgTime , sec.message FROM stompall_chat AS sec LEFT JOIN stompall_room AS ser ON sec.roomId = ser.id WHERE 1=1 AND sec.roomId = #{roomId} ORDER BY sec.id ASC
